facts.text: The drone_base header includes geometry_msgs/msg/twist.hpp, nav_msgs/msg/odometry.hpp, nav_msgs/msg/path.hpp and std_msgs/msg/empty.hpp.
DroneBase::DroneBase registers a relative cmd_vel publisher of geometry_msgs::msg::Twist with queue size 1.
DroneBase::DroneBase subscribes to the absolute /start_mission and /stop_mission topics of std_msgs::msg::Empty with queue size 10.
DroneBase::DroneBase subscribes to the relative base_odom nav_msgs::msg::Odometry and plan nav_msgs::msg::Path topics with queue size 10.
DroneBase::start_mission_callback only sets mission_ to true and returns; it publishes no acknowledgement and starts no takeoff.
DroneBase::stop_mission clears mission_, calls all_stop(), and, only when the state is flight or flight_odom, calls start_action(Action::land).
DroneBase::all_stop publishes a zero velocity through the flight controller.
FlightControllerInterface::publish_velocity clamps throttle, strafe, vertical and yaw each to -1.0..1.0 and publishes them as a geometry_msgs::msg::Twist.
DroneBase::start_action drops the requested action when the action manager is busy; otherwise it calls action_mgr_->send(action, g_actions[action]).
The action manager sends a TelloAction service request with request->cmd set to the action string and then waits for the service future.
The service response's rc is compared with OK, ERROR_BUSY and ERROR_NOT_CONNECTED; an OK response only marks the action as accepted and leaves state waiting_for_response.
The action manager completes an action only when a later tello_response topic message reports success, failure or timeout.
The action manager comment states that tello_driver uses a ROS service plus a ROS topic to simulate an action, and that only one action can be active at a time.
TrajectoryVelocityFlyer.stop sends a zero four-component command when launching or running and explicitly does not try to land the flying drone.
FlockSimplePath publishes the relative cmd_vel Twist topic and subscribes to absolute /start_mission, /stop_mission and /tf; it creates no service or action server.
FlockSimplePath::flyer_cmd_callback passes the flyer's four velocity components through to a geometry_msgs::msg::Twist and publishes it.
The shipped launch starts the drone_base controller and does not start the flock_simple_path script.
The shipped single-drone launch starts drone_base with namespace 'solo'.

safe_state.description: No acknowledged safe stop exists in the pinned clone: /stop_mission is a ROS 2 publication whose callback clears the mission flag, publishes a zero Twist and may forward an asynchronous land request to the external tello_action service; the publication and the service acceptance do not prove that the drone stopped, hovered or landed.
